descriptor: Customer story platform for small teams

voice.summary: Sounds like a thoughtful interviewer: quotes come first, names are real and small details do the persuading. The brand steps back so customers can talk.
dos: Quote customers in their own words
Name the person and the team
Keep the quote to a sentence or two
donts: Do not paraphrase into marketing speak
Do not crowd the quote with logos

taglines: Real voices, right on the page
One honest quote at a time
boilerplate: Sayso is a platform that helps small teams collect, curate and show customer stories as simple rotating quotes, with names, faces and the time to read them.

microcopy.error: That quote couldn't be saved. Try again.
microcopy.empty: No quotes yet. Add your first customer story.

logo.note: A speech bubble is the clearest sign for quotes and spoken words.
